西洋.meaning_logic: 西 (west) + 洋 (Western style; also ‘ocean’) → the West — the lands across the western ocean.

建物.meaning_logic: 建 (build) + 物 (thing) → a built thing → a building. 建 is read たて, the stem of たてる ‘to build’.

part_notes.0: kun'yomi た.てる — the て stays inside the compound (たて + もの).

写真.meaning_logic: 写 (copy) + 真 (reality) → a copy of reality → a photograph.

声優.meaning_logic: 声 (voice) + 優 (superior; the ‘actor’ sense of 優 as in 俳優) → voice actor.

今回.meaning_logic: 今 (now) + 回 (times) → this time — the current turn.

とても.meaning_logic: Native adverb written in kana — no everyday kanji form (迚も is a rare ateji). Means ‘very’.

苦しい.meaning_logic: 苦 (suffering) + okurigana しい → painful, distressing.

試合.meaning_logic: 試 (try) + 合 (suit, fit, join) → a match — trying your skill against another (試し合う).

惜しい.meaning_logic: 惜 (frugal, reluctant to part with) + しい → regrettable — you begrudge losing it.

手紙.meaning_logic: 手 (hand) + 紙 (paper) → paper you write by hand → a letter.

見せる.meaning_logic: 見 (see) + causative せる → to make someone see → to show.

担任.meaning_logic: 担 (carry) + 任 (duty) → carrying a duty → being in charge; a homeroom teacher.

昨日.reading_note: Fixed set reading きのう; the on-reading compound is さくじつ. Neither き nor のう is a usual reading of 昨 or 日.

休む.meaning_logic: 休 (rest) + okurigana む → to rest.

不屈.meaning_logic: 不 (not) + 屈 (yield) → not yielding → unyielding.

駅.meaning_logic: 駅 (station) — a single kanji word read えき.

終点.meaning_logic: 終 (end) + 点 (point) → the final stop.

終電.meaning_logic: 終 (end) + 電 (electricity → electric train) → the last train.

充電.meaning_logic: 充 (allocate, fill) + 電 (electricity) → to fill with electricity → to recharge.

充填.meaning_logic: 充 (fill) + 填 (fill in) → filling, packing. 填 is not taught on WaniKani; its gloss comes from a dictionary.

part_notes.1: WaniKani does not teach 填; on'yomi てん, gloss ‘fill in’ (dictionary fact).

驚く.meaning_logic: 驚 (surprised) + く → to be surprised.

着物.meaning_logic: 着 (wear) + 物 (thing) → a thing to wear → kimono, clothes.

襟.meaning_logic: 襟 (collar) — single kanji, read えり.

袖.meaning_logic: 袖 (sleeve) — single kanji, read そで.

糸.meaning_logic: 糸 (thread) — single kanji, read いと.

母.meaning_logic: 母 (mother) — single kanji, read はは.

郵便.meaning_logic: 郵 (mail) + 便 (service, convenience — as in 便り ‘news’) → the postal service → mail.

雄弁.meaning_logic: 雄 (male, heroic) + 弁 (dialect; here ‘speech’, as in 弁論 ‘debate’) → eloquent.

辺り.meaning_logic: 辺 (area) + okurigana り → the area around → vicinity.

マンション.meaning_logic: Loanword from English ‘mansion’, but in Japanese it means a multi-unit apartment block, not a grand house.

通り.meaning_logic: 通 (pass through) + り → a way that passes through → a street, an avenue.

図.meaning_logic: 図 (diagram) — single kanji, read ず.

絵.meaning_logic: 絵 (picture) — single kanji, read え.

例.meaning_logic: 例 (example) — single kanji, read れい.

来年.meaning_logic: 来 (come; next) + 年 (year) → next year.

歩道.meaning_logic: 歩 (walk) + 道 (road) → a walking road → sidewalk.

パソコン.meaning_logic: Clipped compound of パーソナルコンピューター (‘personal computer’).

音.meaning_logic: 音 (sound) — single kanji, read おと.

聞こえる.meaning_logic: 聞 (hear) + こえる → to be audible.

まじめ.meaning_logic: Native word usually written 真面目 — 真 (true) + 面目 (face, appearance) → a true face → serious, diligent.

私.meaning_logic: 私 (I) — single kanji, read わたし.

国.meaning_logic: 国 (country) — single kanji, read くに.

時間.meaning_logic: 時 (time) + 間 (interval) → an interval of time → time; an hour.

昼.meaning_logic: 昼 (noon) — single kanji, read ひる.

夜.meaning_logic: 夜 (night) — single kanji, read よる.

反対.meaning_logic: 反 (anti) + 対 (opposite) → opposition; the opposite.

時代.meaning_logic: 時 (time) + 代 (era, substitute) → a period, an era.

時期.meaning_logic: 時 (time) + 期 (period) → a time, a season.

時速.meaning_logic: 時 (hour) + 速 (speed) → speed per hour.

自転車.meaning_logic: 自 (self) + 転 (revolve) + 車 (car) → a self-moving vehicle → a bicycle.

壊れる.meaning_logic: 壊 (break) + れる → to get broken.

家.meaning_logic: 家 (house) — single kanji, read いえ.

帰る.meaning_logic: 帰 (return home) + る → to return home.

だらしない.meaning_logic: Native adjective, kana only, of uncertain origin — no kanji to derive it from. Means sloppy, untidy.

しかたない.meaning_logic: From 仕方がない — 仕方 (way, method) + が + ない (none) → ‘there is no way’ → it can’t be helped.

病気.meaning_logic: 病 (sick) + 気 (energy, spirit) → a sick condition → illness.

人.meaning_logic: 人 (person) — single kanji, read ひと.

高校生.meaning_logic: 高 (tall, high) + 校 (school) + 生 (life; here ‘student’, as in 学生) → high school student.

医者.meaning_logic: 医 (medicine) + 者 (someone) → a medicine person → doctor.

決心.meaning_logic: 決 (decide) + 心 (heart) → a decision of the heart → determination.

証明.meaning_logic: 証 (evidence) + 明 (bright, clear) → making something clear with evidence → proof.

仮定.meaning_logic: 仮 (temporary) + 定 (determine) → a temporary determination → an assumption.

彼.meaning_logic: 彼 (he) — single kanji, read かれ.

いつも.meaning_logic: From 何時も — いつ (when) + も (every) → ‘whenever’ → always.

みんな.meaning_logic: Native word; the usual kanji is 皆, which means ‘all, everyone’.

笑わせる.meaning_logic: 笑 (laugh) + causative わせる → to make someone laugh.

面白い.meaning_logic: 面 (face) + 白 (white, bright) → literally ‘face-brightening’ → interesting, amusing; the reading おもしろ is a fixed kun reading of the compound.

文句.meaning_logic: 文 (writing, sentence) + 句 (phrase) → a phrase you say → a complaint.

冗談.meaning_logic: 冗 (superfluous) + 談 (talk) → idle talk → a joke.

自慢.meaning_logic: 自 (self) + 慢 (overconfidence) → pride; to boast.

まだ.meaning_logic: Native adverb; the kanji form is 未だ (未 = not yet). Means ‘still; not yet’.

部屋.meaning_logic: 部 (part) + 屋 (roof, room) → a room.

出かける.meaning_logic: 出 (exit) + かける → to go out.

泊める.meaning_logic: 泊 (overnight) + める → to let someone stay overnight.

空港.meaning_logic: 空 (sky) + 港 (harbor, port) → a port for the sky → an airport.

飛行機.meaning_logic: 飛 (fly) + 行 (go) + 機 (machine) → a flying machine → an airplane.

アナウンス.meaning_logic: Loanword from English ‘announce’; means an announcement.

コマーシャル.meaning_logic: Loanword from English ‘commercial’; clipped to CM in everyday speech.

休日.meaning_logic: 休 (rest) + 日 (day) → a day off.

渋滞.meaning_logic: 渋 (bitter, astringent → sluggish) + 滞 (stagnate) → traffic that stagnates → a traffic jam.

道.meaning_logic: 道 (road) — single kanji, read みち.

空く.meaning_logic: 空 (empty) + く → to be empty, uncrowded.

突然.meaning_logic: 突 (stab; sudden) + 然 (so, nature) → suddenly.

当然.meaning_logic: 当 (correct, hit) + 然 (so) → ‘as it should be’ → natural, obvious.

年中.meaning_logic: 年 (year) + 中 (middle; here ‘throughout’) → all year round.

part_notes.1: read じゅう here, meaning ‘throughout (the year)’ — usual readings ちゅう / なか.

案外.meaning_logic: 案 (plan) + 外 (outside) → outside the plan → unexpectedly.

一生懸命.meaning_logic: 一 (one) + 生 (life) + 懸 (suspend) + 命 (life, fate) → ‘one life hanging’ — risking everything → with all one’s might. A set phrase; the older form is 一所懸命.

立派.meaning_logic: 立 (stand) + 派 (faction) → literally ‘a faction that stands out’ → splendid, admirable; the modern sense is set, not a literal sum.

政治家.meaning_logic: 政 (politics) + 治 (cure; here ‘govern’, as in 政治) + 家 (house; here ‘professional’, as in 画家) → politician.

納得.meaning_logic: 納 (supply, pay in) + 得 (acquire) → taking something in and getting it → being convinced.

注意.meaning_logic: 注 (pour) + 意 (idea, attention) → pouring your mind into something → attention, caution.

朝.meaning_logic: 朝 (morning) — single kanji, read あさ.

ご飯.meaning_logic: ご (polite prefix) + 飯 (meal) → meal; cooked rice.

おなか.meaning_logic: お (polite prefix) + なか ‘inside’ (中) → the inside → belly. Usually written お腹 (腹 = belly).

ぺらぺら.meaning_logic: Onomatopoeia from the flapping of a sheet of paper: ‘flimsy’ for paper, ‘fluent’ for speech that flows off the tongue.

からから.meaning_logic: Onomatopoeia for a dry, rattling sound → parched, bone-dry.

ぺこぺこ.meaning_logic: Onomatopoeia for an empty stomach’s pang → very hungry (also used for bowing repeatedly).

どきどき.meaning_logic: Onomatopoeia for a thumping heartbeat → nervous excitement.

聞く.meaning_logic: 聞 (hear) + く → to hear; to ask.

情報.meaning_logic: 情 (feeling, circumstance) + 報 (news, report) → a report on circumstances → information.

満足.meaning_logic: 満 (full) + 足 (foot; here ‘sufficient’) → full and sufficient → satisfied.

確実.meaning_logic: 確 (certain) + 実 (reality, truth) → certain, reliable.

電気.meaning_logic: 電 (electricity) + 気 (energy) → electricity; electric light.

工事.meaning_logic: 工 (construction) + 事 (matter, work) → construction work.

壁.meaning_logic: 壁 (wall) — single kanji, read かべ.

エアコン.meaning_logic: Clipped compound of エアコンディショナー (‘air conditioner’).

取り付ける.meaning_logic: 取 (take) + 付 (attach) → to take and attach → to install.

取り上げる.meaning_logic: 取 (take) + 上 (up) → to take up → to pick up; to take away.

受け入れる.meaning_logic: 受 (accept) + 入 (enter) → to accept and take in.

引き受ける.meaning_logic: 引 (pull) + 受 (accept) → to pull something onto yourself and accept it → to undertake.

清潔.meaning_logic: 清 (pure) + 潔 (pure, clean) → clean, cleanliness.

柔らかい.meaning_logic: 柔 (gentle) + らかい → soft, tender.

濡れる.meaning_logic: 濡 (wet) + れる → to get wet.

乾く.meaning_logic: 乾 (dry) + く → to get dry.

きれい.meaning_logic: Na-adjective usually written 綺麗 — 綺 (beautiful) + 麗 (lovely) → clean, pretty.

さっき.meaning_logic: Native word from 先 (さき) ‘ahead, previous’ with a doubled consonant → a moment ago.

前.meaning_logic: 前 (front) — single kanji, read まえ.

ゆっくり.meaning_logic: Native adverb, kana only, no standard kanji. Means slowly, at ease.

置く.meaning_logic: 置 (put) + く → to put down.

居間.meaning_logic: 居 (alive → ‘to be, reside’, as in 居る) + 間 (interval, space) → living room.

台所.meaning_logic: 台 (stand, platform — WaniKani gloss ‘machine’) + 所 (place) → the place where the cooking platform stands → kitchen.

廊下.meaning_logic: 廊 (corridor) + 下 (below) → a covered passage → hallway.

風呂.meaning_logic: Set spelling for ふろ ‘bath’: 風 (wind) + 呂 (bath). The kanji spelling is conventional, not a literal compound.

今.meaning_logic: 今 (now) — single kanji, read いま.

指導.meaning_logic: 指 (finger, point) + 導 (lead) → pointing the way and leading → guidance.

そろそろ.meaning_logic: Native reduplicated adverb, kana only. Means ‘soon, gradually, it’s about time’.

おしまい.meaning_logic: お (polite prefix) + 仕舞い (finish, from 仕舞う ‘to finish’) → the end.

食事.meaning_logic: 食 (eat) + 事 (occurrence, matter) → a meal.

にぎる.meaning_logic: Native verb usually written 握る — 握 (grip) + る → to grip, to hold.

引っ越し.meaning_logic: 引 (pull) + 越 (go beyond) → pulling your things to a new place → moving house.

何度.meaning_logic: 何 (what) + 度 (times, degree) → how many times.

家具.meaning_logic: 家 (house) + 具 (tool) → house tools → furniture.

体.meaning_logic: 体 (body) — single kanji, read からだ.

お祭り.meaning_logic: お (polite prefix) + 祭 (festival) + り → a festival.

弟.meaning_logic: 弟 (younger brother) — single kanji, read おとうと.

迷子.meaning_logic: 迷 (astray) + 子 (child) → a child who has gone astray → a lost child.

part_notes.0: on'yomi めい, contracted to まい in this word.

手.meaning_logic: 手 (hand) — single kanji, read て.

しっかり.meaning_logic: Native adverb, kana only, no standard kanji. Means firmly, properly.

風.meaning_logic: 風 (wind) — single kanji, read かぜ.

帽子.meaning_logic: 帽 (hat) + 子 (a suffix for a thing, not ‘child’) → a hat.

生まれる.meaning_logic: 生 (life) + まれる → to be born.

赤ちゃん.meaning_logic: 赤 (red) + ちゃん (affectionate suffix) → a red-faced newborn → a baby.

大事.meaning_logic: 大 (big) + 事 (matter) → a big matter → important.

今朝.reading_note: Fixed set reading けさ, a jukujikun; it cannot be built from the usual readings of 今 (いま/こん) or 朝 (あさ/ちょう).

妻.meaning_logic: 妻 (wife) — single kanji, read つま.

けんか.meaning_logic: Native word usually written 喧嘩 — 喧 (noisy) + 嘩 (noisy) → a noisy clash → a fight, a quarrel.

仲.meaning_logic: 仲 (relationship) — single kanji, read なか.

腕.meaning_logic: 腕 (arm) — single kanji, read うで.

けが.meaning_logic: Ateji 怪我: the kanji are used for sound only — 怪 (mystery) + 我 (self) do not mean ‘injury’.

お店.meaning_logic: お (polite prefix) + 店 (shop) → a shop.

間違える.meaning_logic: 間 (interval) + 違 (different) → something is off/different → to make a mistake.

漢字.meaning_logic: 漢 (Chinese) + 字 (letter) → Chinese characters → kanji.

先生.meaning_logic: 先 (previous) + 生 (born) → one born before you → a senior → a teacher.

目的.meaning_logic: 目 (eye) + 的 (target) → the target of your eye → a purpose, a goal.

今日.reading_note: Fixed set reading きょう, a jukujikun; it cannot be built from the usual readings of 今 (いま/こん) or 日 (ひ/にち).

たくさん.meaning_logic: Usually written 沢山, an ateji-style spelling: 沢 (marsh) + 山 (mountain) are sound-only for たくさん ‘a lot’.

商品.meaning_logic: 商 (merchandise, commerce) + 品 (product, goods) → merchandise.

売れる.meaning_logic: 売 (sell) + れる → to be sold.

超える.meaning_logic: 超 (ultra, beyond) + える → to go beyond, to exceed.

窓側.meaning_logic: 窓 (window) + 側 (side) → the window side.

part_notes.1: compound form of かわ / がわ ‘side’ — here ぎわ.

いい.meaning_logic: Colloquial form of よい, usually written 良い — 良 (good).

海外.meaning_logic: 海 (sea) + 外 (outside) → outside the sea → overseas.

出張.meaning_logic: 出 (go out) + 張 (stretch, extend) → going out to extend the company’s work → a business trip.

薬.meaning_logic: 薬 (medicine) — single kanji, read くすり.

効果.meaning_logic: 効 (effective) + 果 (fruit, result) → the result of being effective → an effect.

子ども.meaning_logic: 子 (child) + ども (plural suffix) → child; children.

気持ち.meaning_logic: 気 (energy, spirit) + 持 (hold) + ち → what you hold in your spirit → a feeling.

見学.meaning_logic: 見 (see) + 学 (study) → learning by seeing → a study visit.

すぐに.meaning_logic: From 直ぐに — 直 (straight, immediate) + ぐ + に → immediately.

友達.meaning_logic: 友 (friend) + 達 (attain; here a plural suffix) → friends; a friend.

都合.meaning_logic: 都 (metropolis) + 合 (fit, combine) → how things fit together → circumstances, convenience; the modern sense is set.

約束.meaning_logic: 約 (promise) + 束 (bundle) → a bundle of agreed terms → a promise.

住所.meaning_logic: 住 (dwell) + 所 (place) → the place where you dwell → an address.

知らせる.meaning_logic: 知 (know) + causative らせる → to make someone know → to inform.

登場.meaning_logic: 登 (climb, enter) + 場 (place, scene) → entering the scene → an appearance.

part_notes.1: 々 repeats 人; ひと → びと (rendaku).

会議.meaning_logic: 会 (meet) + 議 (deliberation, discussion) → a meeting.

司会.meaning_logic: 司 (director; here ‘manage’) + 会 (meet, meeting) → the one who manages the meeting → a host, an MC.

引っ越す.meaning_logic: 引 (pull) + 越 (go beyond) → to pull your things to a new place → to move house.
